assertions.assertion: States that IAuthorizationParametersMessageStore is removed in v8
assertions.rationale: Affirms the interface no longer exists in v8 ('since the interface no longer exists, there's nothing to reimplement').

assertions.assertion: Identifies PAR (Pushed Authorization Requests) as the replacement
assertions.rationale: Correctly infers and names PAR (RFC 9126) as the intended replacement for pushing large authorization parameters.

assertions.assertion: Mentions configuring clients to use require_pushed_authorization_requests or the PAR endpoint
assertions.rationale: Names the require_pushed_authorization_requests client setting and the /connect/par endpoint with the request_uri flow.
Explicitly says there is nothing to reimplement and to drop the old implementation.
